mapper.select: SELECT ke.exchange_id, ke.order_id, fp.ticker, fp.name AS name, so.sell_qty, ke.provisional_amount, ke.provisional_at, ke.final_amount, ke.final_at, ke.settlement_status FROM krw_exchange ke LEFT JOIN sell_order so ON so.order_id = ke.order_id LEFT JOIN foreign_product fp ON fp.foreign_product_id = so.foreign_product_id WHERE ke.account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY ke.provisional_at DESC, ke.exchange_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
